Hi Alice — thanks for the note, and welcome. Short answers up front: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report, a draft bridge letter for audit-period gaps, and a concise artifact checklist for procurement. Secure transfer options: presigned S3 links (preferred), SFTP, or encrypted ZIP via our secure file intake.

Below is a minimal evidence checklist we share with partners (we can expand if your assessor asks for more):
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter (if needed; draft Word)
- Auditor contact: Clearview Audit LLP — Maya Patel, maya.patel@clearviewaudit.com
- Controls matrix (summary of control families mapped to evidence locations)
- Log retention policy & a sample log extract (redacted where applicable)
- Change control snapshot (recent PR & deployment note)
- Backup/restore policy excerpt and a restore test summary
- Incident response timeline (anonymized)
- Network diagram (high-level) and list of cloud regions
- Encryption-at-rest/key-management statement (KMS provider)

Suggested next steps:
1) Confirm the audit period you'd accept (we typically provide reports covering a 12-month window; our latest Type II covers 2024-05-01 — 2025-04-30).
2) Tell us preferred transfer method and any redaction constraints.
3) If you need a bridge letter, we can share a draft for your legal/security review.

I've attached a minimal evidence checklist (CSV/XLS) and will follow up with the redacted report and a draft bridge letter once you confirm the transfer method. If helpful, Ben (cc'ed) — our account lead — can join a short call to walk through priorities.

One-line reply options if you want just the link: 
- "Send presigned S3 link"
- "SFTP credentials please"
- "Email redacted PDF"

Best,
Hannah Schmitt

Redwood Inference
